Comparative Tree-Space Projection and Topological Validation Pipeline

Source: R/validation.R
validate_phylogenies.Rd

Quantifies topological congruence between the focal supermatrix maximum-likelihood tree generated by PhyloCactus and external reference phylogenetic hypotheses (e.g., Amaral et al. 2022, Thompson et al. 2024, de Vos et al. 2025). Employs quantitative tree distance metrics (including Robinson-Foulds, RF, distances and Information-Theoretic distances; TreeDist; Smith, 2020) and multidimensional scaling (MDS) tree-space projections to identify congruent clades and detect topological conflicts across alternative datasets.

Usage

validate_phylogenies(
  trees_mapping_list,
  checklist_csv,
  constraints_map,
  out_dir,
  min_tips = 4L,
  pruning_strategy = c("common_set", "pairwise"),
  rooting_genus = "Leuenbergeria"
)

Arguments

trees_mapping_list

Named list of file paths pointing to Newick/Nexus reference trees and focal tree.

checklist_csv

Character. Path to accepted botanical checklist CSV or Excel file for taxon name standardization (Korotkova et al., 2021).

constraints_map

Character. Path to taxonomy mapping CSV file.

out_dir

Character. Destination directory path to save validation output tables, tree-space plots, and logs.

min_tips

Integer. Minimum number of tips for comparisons. Defaults to 4L.

pruning_strategy

Character. Strategy for pruning trees before metric computation. Under "common_set", the shared intersection across all trees is used for the multidimensional scaling (MDS) projection, whereas pairwise tables retain all shared tips between each pair. Defaults to "common_set".

rooting_genus

Character. Genus whose terminals root every tree after the family filter. Defaults to "Leuenbergeria".

This differs deliberately from the rooting used elsewhere in PhyloCactus. The comparison here is restricted to Cactaceae, so the family filter removes Portulacaceae and Anacampserotaceae before rooting and the outgroup terminals used by the dating pipeline are no longer available. Leuenbergeria is the earliest-diverging lineage retained, which makes it the closest available approximation to the root position the full tree would impose. All terminals of the genus are used, not one, for the reasons given in resolve_rooting_outgroup(). Trees lacking the genus are left unrooted and flagged in SUPP_rooting_summary.

Value

A named list containing file paths for generated tables (tables), figures (figures), trees (trees), and the combined ggplot object (plot).

References

Korotkova, N., Aquino, D., Arias, S., Eggli, U., Franck, A., Gómez-Hinostrosa, C., Guerrero, P. C., Hernández, H. M., Kohlbecker, A., Köhler, M., Luther, K., Majure, L. C., Müller, A., Metzing, D., Nyffeler, R., Sánchez, D., Schlumpberger, B. O., & Berendsohn, W. G. (2021). Cactaceae at Caryophyllales.org - a dynamic online species-level taxonomic backbone for the family. Willdenowia, 51(2), 251-270. doi:10.3372/wi.51.51208

Robinson, D. F., & Foulds, L. R. (1981). Comparison of phylogenetic trees. Mathematical Biosciences, 53(1-2), 131-147. doi:10.1016/0025-5564(81)90043-2

Smith, M. R. (2020). Information theoretic measures of phylogenetic tree distance. Systematic Biology, 69(6), 1168-1182. doi:10.1093/sysbio/syaa016

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
validate_phylogenies(
  trees_mapping_list = list(
    FocalTree = "bestTree.tree",
    Amaral = "Tree_80MD.tre"
  ),
  checklist_csv = "checklist.csv",
  constraints_map = "taxonomy.csv",
  out_dir = "9_Validation"
)
} # }
